entry_thesis: XOM is breaking out of a bull flag consolidation pattern that formed in February 2026, catalyzed by the U.S.-Israel strike on Iran on February 28. Crude oil (WTI) is surging sharply with energy sector momentum at its strongest in years, and XOM's $155-$158 range represents the post-breakout base with a measured move target to all-time highs above $170. Energy is the top YTD sector (+22-25%) while broader market breadth is weakening — classic momentum divergence setup favoring relative strength leaders.
risk: Ceasefire developments or rapid de-escalation in the Iran conflict could reverse the oil price spike and cause a swift pullback; stop-loss at $149 (below the Feb breakout zone and 20-day MA support).
target_return: 10-12% in 15 days based on technical measured move to $171-$175 all-time high range
catalyst: Geopolitical shock from U.S.-Israel Iran strikes driving oil prices toward $100+; bull flag breakout with institutional accumulation evident in above-average volume; energy sector rotation as tech and growth names weaken
